name: jp.xeon.x-scriptable-db
description: A high-performance ScriptableObject-based database system for Unity. Features O(log n) binary search with PrimaryKey, O(1) hash lookup with SecondaryKey, zero GC allocation queries, CSV/TSV import/export with diff preview, SQL Editor with JOIN/GROUP BY/aggregation functions, schema comparison, migration tools, and comprehensive validation system.

samples.description: Sample demonstrating basic usage including record definition, table creation, and search methods.
Sample demonstrating composite SecondaryKey index for fast multi-field lookups.
Interactive demo showcasing all major features with UI controls.
